content.enriched_brief: Make a modern-urban, wealthy-clan animated short drama about a stand-in bride. The female lead, a young woman wearing a cream coat and pearl earrings, is brought in to replace his dead first love. For three years, the man never truly looked at her. On the day her contract expires, she hands him divorce papers. The man, who once ignored her, then begins hunting for her like a madman across the whole city. Add Chinese subtitles for short-video platform distribution and a sad piano BGM.
